description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git diff modes and file permissions. It sets up test cases to verify the behavior of changing file permissions and the output of Git diff commands, including --stat and --shortstat options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description and commands.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Writes the current index to a tree object and outputs its hash.

methods.name: git diff
methods.description: Shows changes between commits, working directory, or index.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message and changes.
